extracted.name: Brown Butter Pumpkin Spice Cookie Butter Cookies
extracted.description: Buttery, spiced, and full of fall flavor—these Brown Butter Pumpkin Spice Cookie Butter Cookies are chewy, cozy, and impossible to eat just one. 🍂✨
ingredient_lines: 12 tsp Cookie butter (Great Value brand or similar)
instruction_lines: Brown butter over medium heat for 5-10 min, then cool.
Mix in brown sugar and white sugar.
Drain pumpkin puree using cheese cloth; add to bowl with vanilla.
Fold in flour, pumpkin pie spice, cinnamon, baking soda, and salt.
Scoop 1 tsp cookie butter onto parchment; freeze until firm.
Scoop about 2 tbsp dough per cookie, flatten, wrap around frozen cookie butter, and seal.
Chill dough balls for 30 min; keep cookie butter frozen until use.
